title: Waada Apna Nibhadiya Sheh ne
body:
Wada apna nibha diya sheh ne
Haqq pe sar ko kata diya sheh ne
Rahey haq me luta ke ghar apna
Deen-e-haq ko bacha liya sheh ne
<<DIVIDER>>
Dey key apna lahu bhi karbal ko
Arsh-e-aala bana diye sheh ne
Baandha rumaal-e-Fatima sar par
Hoor ka rutba badha diya sheh ne
<<DIVIDER>>
Barchi ka phal jo dekha seeney mein
Apne gham ko bhula diya sheh ne
Hai wo Iqbal aj apna watan
Sehrey gham ko basa liya sheh ne
